items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: He sure did. And for Frank.

ctx.x: Yeah well I met my wife and we got married in ’65. And that’s when I left Woody’s band. She’s fantastic. I mean she like, saves my life you know. And actually when we got married, I’ve got to tell you this story if you don’t mind, I told Woody I was going to get married. He goes, “You what? You’re what?” We’re sitting on a counter in a coffee shop. He says, “You’re getting married, what? Are you kidding?” I said, “Yeah, we’re getting married.” I said, “We’ve got to set a date” you know. And he says, “Oh, you…
He sure did. And for Frank.
Yeah. Oh I miss him man. He was my brother.
